title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 29
paragraphs: Histiaeus was taken prisoner in the following manner. As the Hellenes were fighting the Persians at Malene in the district of Atarneus, after they had been engaged in close combat for a long time, at length the cavalry charged and fell upon the Hellenes; and the cavalry in fact decided the battle. So when the Hellenes had been put to flight, Histiaeus, trusting that he would not be put to death by the king for his present offense, conceived a love of life; so that when he was being caught in his flight by a Persian and was about to be run through at the moment of capture, he spoke in Persian and made himself known, saying that he was Histiaeus the Milesian.
